prod-cctv-networking-cp-z43q.title: CP Plus 4MP Wi-Fi Full Color PT Camera - CP-Z43Q
prod-cctv-networking-cp-z43q.description: High-definition 4MP PT camera engineered for residential and commercial site surveillance. Delivers vivid full-color video streaming day and night with intelligent motion tracking and instant smartphone alerts. Built with robust weatherproof casing and dual-band Wi-Fi for uninterrupted monitoring.
specBullets: 4MP Quad HD resolution with crystal clear zoom details
360° horizontal pan and 90° vertical tilt motorized control
Smart full-color night vision with dual high-power white LEDs
Full duplex two-way audio with built-in noise cancelling microphone
Supports up to 256GB MicroSD card and secure cloud storage
